prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Select a pet companion personality and appearance that fits your daily desktop routine."]
1: ["Customize Companion Traits", "Fine-tune your pet's core energy and responsiveness before completing adoption.", "Continue to Photos"]
2: ["Building Your Custom Companion", "Generating pet graphics, desktop physics, and behavior patterns..."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "Your pet will now appear directly on your desktop screen. Click or drag to interact."]
4: ["Pet generation typically takes under 2 minutes. We will alert you as soon as your pet is ready."]
5: ["Signing in ensures your adopted pets and progress are safely backed up to your account."]
6: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and simple backgrounds."]
7: ["Choose Your Adoption Experience", "Select whether to adopt a pre-designed desktop pet or create a custom companion from your photos."]
8: ["Official Companion Adoption Seal", "Certified Pet"]
9: ["Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open companion controls and options."]
